title: Leytonstone Emergency Help Points
summary: Critical hospital access, Hollow Ponds flood areas, and shopping hubs for Leytonstone (E11).
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Whipps Cross Hospital, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone E11 1NR. Travel guidance: from Leytonstone station, ~18 min walk north along Church Lane and Whipps Cross Road, or take bus 257 or W15 directly to the hospital entrance. For specialized major trauma, The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Whitechapel Road, Whitechapel E1 1FR. Travel guidance: from Leytonstone station, take the Central line directly west to Mile End/Whitechapel, or ~20 min drive via A12. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Whipps Cross Urgent Treatment Centre, located inside the emergency building at Whipps Cross Hospital, Whipps Cross Road E11 1NR (operates 24 hours daily). 3. Area Hazards: Surface water run-off and localized flooding around Hollow Ponds / Epping Forest lower drainage basins and underpasses near the A12 corridor during severe downpours. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and large grocery retailers along Leytonstone High Road, Church Lane, and near Leytonstone High Road station supply drinking water, batteries, first-aid materials, and critical medicines during outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
